title: Maybelline New York updates its 35-year-old ‘Maybe she’s born with it’ tagline
summary: The L’Oréal-owned make-up brand has revamped its famous tagline, which first debuted in 1991, to reflect the brand’s “next chapter” and how women see beauty today. Sandrine Jolly, Global Brand President of Maybelline New York, reveals the new tagline and campaign with Miley Cyrus below

title: Dove moisturising claims supported by US advertising watchdog after P&G challenge
summary: The National Advertising Division supported claims related to Unilever-owned Dove’s Deep Moisture Body Wash, which were challenged by Procter and Gamble, including that the product offers 24-hours of moisturisation and nourishes dry skin

title: Is beauty’s new comedic marketing strategy proof the industry needs to lighten up?
summary: As a number of brands across beauty and wellness place comedians at the forefront of their campaigns, Cosmetics Business explores how male comics have become a central part of the beauty marketing conversation

title: E.l.f. Beauty leaks CEO Tarang Amin’s number in marketing stunt
summary: The beauty giant is giving customers a direct line to its CEO via the ‘Dial 0 for Zero Distance’ campaign, where they can tell Amin what causes matter most to them and where e.l.f. Beauty can make a bigger impact

title: Coty to restructure France operations amid turnaround efforts
summary: The Kylie Cosmetics and Rimmel London owner has ‘proposed to adapt its operating model’ in France as part of its plans to halt declining sales under its ‘Coty:Curated’ strategy

title: Olive Young to open five more US stores in significant K-beauty expansion
summary: K-Beauty retailer Olive Young’s new US stores will be located across Greater Los Angeles and San Diego, with plans to complete construction on all five sites in the first half of 2027

title: Kim Kardashian's Skims Beauty is coming next year, but can it survive in the current market?
summary: Kim Kardashian is banking on her upcoming Skims Beauty launch in 2027 being a success. But can the celebrity mogul's latest beauty venture stick the landing in what is beauty’s most competitive era?

title: NUBIRAWAVE: Iberchem’s new digital platform to create blooming fragrances with emotional benefits
summary: Following the launch of O-DOOR in 2025, Iberchem continues to integrate data-driven tools into its fragrance creation process, empowering perfumers with greater creativity, flexibility, and precision

title: Vytrus launched Hydranode for skin hydration at in-cosmetics Asia
summary: Vytrus Biotech launched Hydranode at in-cosmetics Asia 2026, introducing hydration by activation, not by water supply. Inspired by the drought resilience of the Mediterranean forest, this biotech ferment acts on the skin microbiota to activate the Skin Hydric Interactome, boosting water transport and barrier function. Clinical studies show significant improvements in both surface and deep hydration from day 7, along with a more even water distribution and visibly plumper skin..

title: There's a simple way to see what your customers' skin really needs. Most brands aren't using it
summary: Many beauty brands already offer AI skin analysis on their website or in store – but only to recommend products. Added together, the same analyses show what an entire audience's skin needs. Here is how marketing teams turn them into campaign, range and assortment decisions
